subject: Proposal: lateral moves & reporting matrix — Core Serving
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: lateral moves & reporting matrix — Core Serving

Team —

I circulated a draft reorg matrix this morning (attached) that proposes a small set of lateral moves across Core Serving to better group model infra and runtime ownership. High level: 4 ICs would shift reporting to two senior tech leads (Matthew/Elena placeholders in the sheet), and two roles would be re-scoped from feature delivery to infra ownership.

Why now:
- We need clearer ownership for model compilation & quant selection to reduce cross-team churn.
- Upcoming onboarding for the Dedicated team favors centralized kernel workstreams.

Immediate asks:
1) Markus — can you confirm there are no blockers on the 2 engineering manager assignments for Q4?
2) Monica — need HR runbook on how to communicate lateral moves vs promotions (comp impacts attached).
3) Grace — can you sanity-check the performance gating note in tab "timing"? I purposely left two roles in a deferred bucket for end-of-cycle reviews.

Attachments: redwood_reorg_matrix_v1.xlsx, comp_impact_summary.pdf (stubs)

Timeline suggestion:
- Agree today/tomorrow internally -> finalize with People Ops by Fri -> announce to impacted individuals next week (1:1s before group note).

I kept this intentionally minimal — want to avoid premature noise. Reply with edits or call if helpful.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Platform Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: lateral moves & reporting matrix — Core Serving

Maya — thanks for the clear draft. A few quick notes inline and below.

Inline:
- On the managers: I can take one of the newly scoped infra leads but will need headcount reallocation from the feature pod. Is the intent to swap a vacated manager slot or create a new band-level role?
- For the two roles you listed as "deferred", we should mark them explicitly as "end of cycle consideration" so TLs don't pre-announce.

Risks/asks:
- Comp impact: the comp_impact_summary shows 3 potential bump candidates. We should scope budget approvals with Finance before confirming.
- Operational continuity: we must keep a 2-week shadow between old/new owners for KV cache and compilation handoffs; add that to the communication timeline.

I'll mock a manager assignment column in the sheet and push a revision later today. If Monica can outline the exact message we want for "lateral vs promotion" language, we can standardize the 1:1 script.

- Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Compute & Serving

Thanks, Maya.

A few HR/process notes from People Ops:
1) Lateral move vs promotion language: we recommend a short script that emphasizes continuity of comp and title unless explicitly raising the band. Lateral moves should be presented as role-focus changes ("ownership of compilation kernels") rather than demotions.
2) Comp approvals: per policy, any comp uplift > 5% requires VP-level signoff + Finance. The comp_impact_summary looks like two cases exceed that threshold — please flag them in the sheet.
3) Sensitive coordination: any affected individual who is currently on a PIP or mid-cycle performance improvement conversation must have People Ops looped in early. We need to avoid surprises.

Process steps I recommend:
- Today: finalize the manager assignment column and mark any >5% comp impact.
- Tomorrow: People Ops and Finance quick sync (30m) to approve budget.
- Thu/Fri: 1:1s with impacted ICs (manager + People Ops optional).

Links for legal/process: https://hr.peoplepartners.io/redwood/reorg-guidance
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/pack/REORG-ANNOUNCE-2026 (for acknowledgement templates)

Attaching comp_impact_summary.pdf (stub). I'll redact any performance notes from the shared sheet — sensitive cells will be hidden.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior People Partner, Redwood Inference
People Ops

Can we split the announcement so the clean moves go out first and the deferred two remain private until we're past off-cycle calibrations? I can own the deferred 1:1 schedule.

Also, Markus — thank you for the shadow period suggestion; +1 and let's add explicit handover tasks to the sheet (KV cache, compile tests, CI gates).

Thanks all — summary and next steps below so we have one canonical path forward.

Decisions:
- Proceed with the 3 clean lateral moves in the sheet today.
- Defer 2 roles (R. and K.) until after mid-cycle calibration; Grace will run those 1:1s.
- Markus will own the manager assignment column and add a 2-week shadow for each handover.
- Monica/People Ops to flag any >5% comp uplift cases and route to Finance for signoff.

Timeline:
- Wed EOD: Markus to push updated sheet (I will not share broadly until Thu AM).
- Thu AM: People Ops + Finance 30m sync (Monica to schedule).
- Thu afternoon: Managers conduct 1:1s for the 3 confirmed moves (people ops optional).
- Fri: Announcement draft to Exec Comms for legal review; Maya to share announcement template.

Attachments: redwood_reorg_matrix_v1.xlsx (updated pending), comp_impact_summary.pdf (redacted).

Communication guidance: short 1:1 scripts (attached in DocuSign template), emphasize no immediate comp changes unless approved, and outline the 2-week shadow/handovers.

I'll schedule a 30m sync with Markus + Monica + Grace at 10:30am Thu to close the loop; calendar invite shortly.

Thanks for quick bandwidth here. I know this is sensitive; happy to take any pushback offline.

— Maya
